title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E9 — Perfect Weekend Breakfast
Martha invites Oscar de la Renta co-creative director Laura Kim to her kitchen to create her Instagrammable and aesthetically pleasing recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E10 — Jacques Pepin Cooking His Way
Culinary legend Jacques Pepin brings his authentic French flavors to Martha's kitchen, crafting a delicious, flavorful menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E1 — Martha Throws an Argentine Asado BBQ
Martha is throwing a very special BBQ called Asado; plus Martha prepares a chimichurri sauce, her daughter Alexis's chopped salad and for dessert, fruit flavored popsicles; a perfect celebration.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E5 — Shellfish
Martha takes shellfish to the next level with sustainable oysters, baked stuffed clams and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E6 — Steak Night
From a pan seared steak with bordelaise sauce to a classic sizzling steak fired up on the grill, Martha makes steak dinners cooked to perfection with the help of her Head of Culinary at the farm.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E8 — Paella on an Open Fire
Martha creates the perfect menu for a paella party that will have your guests coming back for seconds; her paella is served with gazpacho and her incredible sangria.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E18 — Wedding Cake 101; Wedding Good Thing; Calla Lily Bouquet
Wedding cake; Victorian bouquet; wedding ideas.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E20 — Drop Biscuits; Hyman Hendler; Trimming Pillowcases; Tapenade
Biscuits; ribbon store; trimming pillowcases.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S4 E23 — Chocolate Chip Angel Food Cake; Manhattan Fruitier
Wedding bouquet; chocolate-chip angel food; Manhattan fruit dealer.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S5 E2 — Autumn Pantry; Wobbly Chair Repair; Three-Garlic Pasta
Autumn pantry organizing; web clamp, repairing wobbly chairs; three-garlic pasta; sharpening and cleaning garden tools.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S5 E3 — San Francisco (Field Trip); Oysters; Unusual Ribbons
San Francisco field trip; Hog Island Oyster Farming; edible school yard; Bell'occhio.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S5 E5 — Painting the Front Door; Cutting Board Salad; Sun Prints
Painting front doors; cutting board salad; making sun prints; covering school books.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E1 — Eat Your Greens
Sorrel soup; pasta with grilled sardines and bitter greens; Swiss chard frittata; kale Caesar salad; escarole.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E2 — One-Pot Meals
Stovetop clambake in a stockpot; risotto with shrimp and herbs in a pressure cooker; poached cod with tomatoes in a skillet; arroz con pollo in a Dutch oven.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E4 — Mushrooms
Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E5 — Sandwiches
Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E7 — French Bistro Classics
Lamb navarin; Niçoise salad; a melted ham and cheese croque monsieur topped with a béchamel sauce; celery root rémoulade.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E11 — Southwest
Anise seed-flavored cookies called biscochitos; flan, a custard topped with caramel; tres leches cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E12 — South
Buttermilk pie; bourbon bread pudding; carrot cake with orange cream cheese frosting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E1 — Updated Classics
Rhubarb and raspberry rye crisps; flaky buttermilk barley biscuits; spelt layer cake with whipped cream and berries.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E2 — Coffee Shop Favorites
Apple cider doughnut cake with whole grain wheat flour and applesauce; maple-glazed pumpkin spelt scones; seeded graham biscotti.
